name: messenger
description: Facebook messages: read and send your Facebook account's Messenger chats here, never through the browser. A real user, not a bot: chats (including end-to-end encrypted ones), messages, files, voice messages, reactions, edits, groups, bans and blocks. The login is taken from the Facebook session in bia's Chrome. Received files are saved in /home/bia/files/inbox/messenger/; voice messages arrive transcribed as [speech <lang>]; edits, deletions and reactions arrive as [edited <id>], [deleted] and [reaction] lines. No calls. The login is restored by itself at boot.
examples: root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|log into my messenger -> discover(path='mcp/messenger', enable=true); messenger_login()  (if Chrome is not signed in: chrome_start, sign in at https://www.facebook.com/, then messenger_login() again)
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|find Ann Lee on messenger -> messenger_search(query='Ann Lee')
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|send hi to that messenger chat -> messenger_send(chat_id='100012345678', text='hi')
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|send Ann a voice message saying I am late -> messenger_send_voice(chat_id='100012345678', text='Hi, I am running about ten minutes late.', lang='en')
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|make a messenger group Trip with Ann and Bob -> messenger_create_group(title='Trip', members=['Ann Lee', 'Bob Stone'])
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|make Ann an admin of the Trip group -> messenger_set_admin(chat_id='t7712345678901234', member='Ann Lee')
